# Additional supplied GPL source

EDC15P_checksum.cs (MTX Electronics 2007–2012) and EDC15PFileParser.cs are retained unchanged from VAGEDCSuite_Source_1.4.1.5.zip. The supplied root LICENSE grants GPLv3. Both the old and master archives were inspected. The arithmetic routines were compiled independently with C# and compared against 256 synthetic vectors retained in tests/checksum-csharp-vectors.json. No proprietary application binaries or customer data are included.
